background signing: REUSE one persistent signer iframe instead of booting a fresh wallet per call. The SDK now loads the wallet ONCE in a hidden ?bgsvc=1 iframe, waits for a nadoBgReady ping, then streams every sign request over postMessage (serialised via a queue) — so the ~1s wallet/crypto boot is paid once per game page, not on every move/spin/settle. The wallet installs a persistent message handler that reuses the exact same decide+sign path, and a BGSVC guard keeps the hidden signer lean: NO mining (would've been a duplicate miner in an invisible iframe), no dashboard, no pollers. Robust fallback preserved: service never readies (framing blocked) → 12s → redirect everything; request times out → redirect; locked/needs-confirm → redirect + learned _bgOff/_bgValueUI so later calls skip straight to it.

pets: FIX eggs that won't hatch — hatch/rebirth passed the pid as-is, but when you pick an egg from the grid the pid is a STRING (el.dataset.pet). The contract computes gene = HASH(bh0 + bh1 + pid), and that '+ pid' is arithmetic, so a string pid hits the VM's int type-gate → 'expected int' → revert (no-op). Every other pets call already coerces Number(pid); hatch and rebirth were the only two that didn't. Diagnosed from the live exec log (645867…hatch by ndo27f2870bb… -> revert (no-op), repeatedly) and reproduced against the real egg storage: hatch([239444704]) ok=True, hatch(['239444704']) reverts. randId is 1..1e9 so Number() is always lossless. Both stuck eggs now hatch in the harness
